description: This file is a shell script that manages Wireguard VPN configurations on a Linux system. It includes functions for initializing, setting up, tearing down, and configuring Wireguard interfaces and peers, and interacts with system components like ip link, uci configuration, and the Wireguard tools.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes Wireguard configuration parameters with default values.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures an individual Wireguard peer based on provided configuration.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Checks if a private key exists for a given interface, generates one if needed, and stores it.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up a Wireguard interface based on provided configuration, including IP addresses, keys, and peers.
